headline: G2 GOLDFIELDS HITS DEPTH: 84.5m at 3.0 g/t Au extends OKO's vertical reach to 1km in Guyana
snippet: Hole GDD277B returned 84.5m at 3.0 g/t Au from 915m depth at G2 Goldfields' OKO Project in Guyana — including 6.0m at 13.4 g/t Au and 16.4m at 4.5 g/t Au — extending mineralization 140m vertically to 1km. The deposit remains open at depth, adding further scale to a high-grade resource the company is advancing toward a larger estimate.

headline: POWER METALLIC INTERCEPTS 17.45m at 9.47% CuEq and 39m at 5.66% CuEq at Lion Zone ahead of 2026 MRE
snippet: Power Metallic Mines (TSXV: PNPN) cut 17.45m at 9.47% CuEq — including 6.3m at 17.91% — in hole 26-094, and 39m at 5.66% CuEq 100m to the east in hole 26-101 at the Lion Zone, Quebec. The infill campaign covers ~200m of strike at roughly 100m vertical depth, building the dataset for a 2026 Mineral Resource Estimate.

headline: HISTORIC FED SPLIT: 8-4 vote holds rates as gold tests $4,540 three-week low on Middle East risk
snippet: Gold slid to $4,540/oz on May 4, its lowest level since late March, as escalating Middle East tensions elevated inflation risk. The Federal Reserve held rates at 3.50%–3.75% in an 8-4 dissenting vote — the most divided FOMC meeting since 1992 — signaling a fractured central bank at a critical juncture for precious metals positioning.

headline: SILVER AT $73.96 ON MAY 5 — Up more than $41 from a year ago as sixth straight supply deficit looms
snippet: Silver traded at $73.96/oz Tuesday morning, up $0.25 on the day and more than $41 higher than a year earlier. The Silver Institute projects a sixth consecutive structural supply deficit in 2026 of roughly 67 million ounces, as solar and electronics industrial demand continues to outpace flat mine output.

headline: USA RARE EARTH SURGES 72% IN APRIL on $2.8B Serra Verde deal — Washington's rare earth bet takes shape
snippet: USA Rare Earth (USAR) gained 71.6% in April after announcing a $2.8B agreement to acquire Serra Verde Group, owner of a heavy rare-earth mine and separation plant in Brazil. The deal extends a prior $1.6B Trump administration equity stake and positions USAR as the dominant non-China heavy rare-earth producer outside of MP Materials.

headline: ZODIAC GOLD DEPLOYS DRONE LIDAR ACROSS 16km LIBERIA TREND ahead of Q4 2026 resource estimate
snippet: Zodiac Gold (TSXV: ZAU) launched a high-resolution drone magnetic and LiDAR survey at 50m line spacing across its 16km Arthington-Youth Camp trend in Liberia. Interpretation feeds into an ongoing 14,000m drill program targeting a Q4 2026 mineral resource estimate — with 2,343m completed across 13 holes so far.

headline: COPPER NEAR THREE-WEEK LOW as US-Iran war pressure mounts; smelter TC/RC collapses to -$77/t
snippet: Comex copper tested three-week lows near $5.85/lb as US-Iran tensions rattled risk appetite, while smelter treatment and refining charges falling to -$77/t signal a structural concentrate squeeze. Analysts argue that a prolonged conflict is a net medium-term bullish catalyst for copper on supply disruption, even as near-term demand uncertainty weighs.

headline: WHO'S WINNING THE 2026 EXPLORATION RACE? Junior mining capital shifts toward high-grade drill targets
snippet: African Mining Online maps where junior exploration budgets are concentrating in 2026, identifying a pronounced shift from district-scale land positions toward tight, high-grade targets with near-term resource estimate catalysts. West Africa, East Africa, and Congo are flagged as dominant capital destinations as the bull market in gold encourages tighter drill spacing.

headline: NEWMONT'S MARGIN SQUEEZE WAS PREDICTABLE: Rising costs eat into record gold prices for big producers
snippet: The Motley Fool argues that Newmont shareholders should have anticipated rising per-ounce all-in sustaining costs despite record gold prices, as fuel, labor, and royalty creep compresses operating margins at large producers. The piece implicitly highlights why investors seeking gold leverage are increasingly rotating toward lean-cost juniors and near-term developers.

headline: COT REPORT MAY 1: Managed money adds gold net longs as USD weakens; silver positioning turns bullish
snippet: The May 1 Commitments of Traders report (positions dated April 28) shows managed money adding net long positioning in gold as the US dollar pulled back from recent highs. GoldSeek's analysis highlights key speculative flow shifts in silver as well, flagging technical support and resistance levels heading into a volatile macro week defined by the Fed's surprise 8-4 rate split.

headline: CORE LITHIUM AWARDS A$50M NRW MINING CONTRACT as Finniss lithium ore extraction begins in May 2026
snippet: Core Lithium awarded a A$50M mining contract to NRW Holdings for ore extraction at the Finniss lithium project in the Northern Territory, with mining commencing in May 2026 and first spodumene concentrate targeted for Q3 2026. The restart is backed by a A$290M funding package including Glencore Australia and Nebari, marking a sector recovery signal after the 2024–25 lithium price trough.

headline: CANADA GREENLIGHTS WHEELER RIVER: Denison's ISR uranium mine gets first construction licence in 20 years
snippet: Canada's Nuclear Safety Commission issued a site preparation and construction licence for Denison Mines' Wheeler River Phoenix project in the Athabasca Basin — the first uranium mine construction approval in Canada in over 20 years and the country's first in-situ recovery uranium project. The licence runs to February 2031; production is targeted for mid-2028.
